name: Haverford Township Playground Camp
description_short: Outdoor township playground camp for Haverford Township residents ages 6 to 12 at seven neighborhood parks (Coopertown, Grange, Hilltop, Merwood, Paddock, Veterans and Westgate). Kids play sports, group games and dodgeball and do crafts and special theme days; only township residents can register.
notes: 2026: June 22 to July 30, Monday to Thursday 9:00 to 3:00 and Friday 10:00 to 3:00, Life Be In It day July 31. Seven park sites; the address shown is Hilltop Park, one of the seven. Residents only; registration opened March 29, 2026. Fees not posted on the camp page. Campers bring lunch, water and sunscreen.
